profile.name: Sujit Pranav Reddy
profile.title: Engineering Lead
profile.summary: Engineering Lead with 11+ years building scalable SaaS platforms, modernizing monoliths, designing microservices, and engineering high-availability systems. Ruby on Rails developer with 3+ years hands-on delivering AI-powered applications using Python, FastAPI, TensorFlow, and PyTorch for intelligent search, recommendation systems, document processing, LLM integrations, and automation. Experienced building agentic workflows with Claude MCP, Codex MCP, OpenAI APIs, Anthropic Claude, and the Model Context Protocol (MCP).
profile.education: B.Tech, Jawaharlal Nehru Technological University, Hyderabad (2008-2012).

experience.summary: Designed an AI-powered résumé-parsing & candidate-intelligence platform - NLP skill extraction, ranking, and semantic matching. Built LLM recruitment workflows with RAG, vector search, prompt engineering, and structured outputs, plus agentic dev pipelines with Claude MCP and Codex MCP, and document pipelines with OCR, embeddings, and semantic search.

Led development on Storable Edge, an all-in-one self-storage operations platform. Drove sprint planning, effort estimation, and roadmap alignment; performed code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring. Contributed to microservice integrations, API design, and performance tuning; used Claude MCP for agentic development and improved deployments with Docker, GitHub Actions, and Jenkins.

Led backend modernization of a large-scale e-commerce monolith powering thousands of daily transactions. Built a DevOps stack (AWS + Docker + GitHub Actions), raised release velocity 2x, and cut incident response >40% with Grafana + New Relic. Designed a PyTorch + FastAPI recommendation engine on user/product embeddings, integrated with the Rails platform, and improved search relevance with Algolia.

Designed predictive-analytics models with Python and TensorFlow to estimate influencer engagement, reach, and campaign ROI. Built budget-optimization algorithms on historical + costing data, contributed to architecture and sprint planning, and streamlined microservice deployment with existing Kubernetes pods and Docker images.

Designed architecture for new enterprise HR features used by high-volume global clients. Led sprint planning across cross-functional teams and improved CI/CD via Jenkins + AWS, reducing deployment failures. Supported multi-client delivery for Workday, SuccessFactors, Marriott, and J&J.

experience.role: Senior RoR Developer / Associate Tech Lead
experience.summary: Designed architecture for critical new features, optimized queries, and improved search with ElasticSearch & Kibana. Raised overall performance >10% and built a complete DevOps pipeline (Docker + GitHub Actions + AWS) enabling zero-downtime deployments.

Architected and developed the platform end-to-end - design, DB schema, APIs, auth, workflows. Built CI/CD with Jenkins on AWS, introduced Docker-based environments, and implemented CloudWatch-driven alerting to improve uptime.

Restructured the SaaS multi-tenant architecture, cutting maintenance costs 80% by consolidating multiple codebases into a unified Rails Engines platform. Built CI/CD with Jenkins + Docker and integrated New Relic APM for production monitoring.
Built and maintained the backend for a high-traffic e-commerce application; optimized the product catalog and API performance for Android/iOS mobile apps.
Installed and configured BigBlueButton for live audio/video, screen share, and virtual classrooms; upgraded legacy Rails apps from 3.2 to 5.2 and integrated conferencing APIs.
Worked on Ruby on Rails applications - feature development, debugging, and enhancing CMS-based products.
